verdict.rationale: Vanta's dedicated Risk product page confirms a risk management workflow with automated reminders and periodic reassessment (vanta-docs-22, vanta-docs-48), and the Manage Vanta API lets you assign an accountable owner to a control's compliance status (vanta-docs-30), showing some owner/control linkage. However, the evidence never describes risk scoring methodology, formal treatment plans, or explicit review-cycle cadences tied back to controls in a structured register. Missing for 10: documentation of risk scoring/severity models, treatment plan workflows, and explicit review-cycle-to-control mapping beyond generic 'automates reminders' language.
